import unittest

from depres import max_satisfying, satisfies


class ContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertMatches(self, range_, versions, not_versions=()):
        for v in versions:
            self.assertTrue(satisfies(v, range_), f"{v} should satisfy {range_!r}")
        for v in not_versions:
            self.assertFalse(satisfies(v, range_), f"{v} should not satisfy {range_!r}")

    def test_operator_spacing(self):
        self.assertMatches(">= 1.2.3 < 2", ["1.2.3", "1.9.0"], ["1.2.2", "2.0.0"])
        self.assertMatches(">=1.2.3", ["1.2.3"], ["1.2.2"])

    def test_empty_and_star(self):
        self.assertMatches("", ["0.0.0", "10.1.2"])
        self.assertMatches("*", ["1.2.3"], ["1.2.3-alpha"])
        self.assertMatches("X", ["3.0.0"], ["3.0.0-rc.1"])

    def test_partial_with_operators(self):
        self.assertMatches(">1", ["2.0.0"], ["1.9.9"])
        self.assertMatches(">1.2", ["1.3.0"], ["1.2.9"])
        self.assertMatches(">=1.2", ["1.2.0"], ["1.1.9"])
        self.assertMatches("<1.2", ["1.1.9"], ["1.2.0"])
        self.assertMatches("<=1", ["1.9.9"], ["2.0.0"])
        self.assertMatches("<=1.2", ["1.2.9"], ["1.3.0"])
        self.assertMatches("=1.2", ["1.2.0", "1.2.9"], ["1.3.0"])

    def test_x_ranges(self):
        self.assertMatches("1", ["1.0.0", "1.9.9"], ["2.0.0"])
        self.assertMatches("1.2", ["1.2.5"], ["1.3.0"])
        self.assertMatches("1.2.x", ["1.2.5"], ["1.3.0"])

    def test_invalid_wildcard_order(self):
        for bad in ["1.x.3", "x.2", "*.1"]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=bad):
                satisfies("1.0.0", bad)

    def test_hyphen(self):
        self.assertMatches("1.2.3 - 2.3", ["1.2.3", "2.3.9"], ["1.2.2", "2.4.0"])
        self.assertMatches("1.2.3 - 2", ["2.9.9"], ["3.0.0"])

    def test_tilde(self):
        self.assertMatches("~1.2.3", ["1.2.3", "1.2.9"], ["1.3.0", "1.2.2"])
        self.assertMatches("~1.2", ["1.2.0"], ["1.3.0"])
        self.assertMatches("~1", ["1.9.0"], ["2.0.0"])
        self.assertMatches("~1.2.3-beta.2", ["1.2.3-beta.2", "1.2.3"], ["1.3.0"])

    def test_caret(self):
        self.assertMatches("^1.2.3", ["1.9.0"], ["2.0.0"])
        self.assertMatches("^0.2.3", ["0.2.9"], ["0.3.0"])
        self.assertMatches("^0.0.3", ["0.0.3"], ["0.0.4"])
        self.assertMatches("^1.2", ["1.9.0"], ["2.0.0"])
        self.assertMatches("^0.2", ["0.2.9"], ["0.3.0"])
        self.assertMatches("^0.0", ["0.0.9"], ["0.1.0"])
        self.assertMatches("^0.0.x", ["0.0.9"], ["0.1.0"])
        self.assertMatches("^1", ["1.9.9"], ["2.0.0"])
        self.assertMatches("^0", ["0.9.9"], ["1.0.0"])
        self.assertMatches("^0.x", ["0.9.9"], ["1.0.0"])

    def test_union_and_empty_set(self):
        self.assertMatches("1.0.0 ||", ["1.0.0", "9.9.9"])
        self.assertMatches("^1.0.0 || ^3.0.0", ["3.1.0"], ["2.0.0"])

    def test_prerelease_rule(self):
        self.assertMatches(">=1.2.3-alpha.1 <1.3.0", ["1.2.3-alpha.7"], ["1.2.4-alpha.1"])
        self.assertMatches("^1.0.0", [], ["2.0.0-rc.1", "1.5.0-beta"])
        self.assertMatches("*", [], ["1.2.3-alpha"])
        self.assertMatches("", [], ["1.2.3-alpha"])

    def test_build_metadata_ignored(self):
        self.assertMatches("1.2.3", ["1.2.3+build.5", "v1.2.3"])

    def test_invalid_inputs(self):
        for bad in [">=", "1.2.3.4", "foo", ">= >= 1.0.0", "1.2.3 -"]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=bad):
                satisfies("1.0.0", bad)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            satisfies("not-a-version", "*")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            max_satisfying(["1.0.0", "bogus"], "*")


class MaxSatisfyingContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_returns_original_string(self):
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["v1.4.0", "1.3.0"], "^1"), "v1.4.0")

    def test_prerelease_excluded_from_max(self):
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["1.0.0", "1.1.0-beta"], "^1"), "1.0.0")

    def test_empty_input(self):
        self.assertIsNone(max_satisfying([], "*"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# Summary: range matching (`satisfies`, `max_satisfying`)

## What changed
